# Input

`game.input` registers key bindings at runtime and reads keys, chords and the mouse. The kit is Experimental in the [stability tiers](stability.md). `game.input.binding_just_pressed` (older) reads a binding.

`register_key` creates a binding the player can rebind in the game's key options. Keys are Unity key names (`K`, `F9`, `LeftArrow`), `key_names()` lists them. For text, use `game.widgets.prompt`.

```lua
game.input.register_key("MyMod_Overview", "Open the overview", "F9")
game.events.on_tick(function()
  if game.input.binding_just_pressed("MyMod_Overview") then print("pressed") end
  if game.input.chord_pressed("ctrl+shift+K") then print("chord") end
end)
```

## Functions

| Function | Parameters | Returns | Description |
|----------|------------|---------|-------------|
| `game.input.register_key` | `name, label?, default?, category?` | `boolean` | Makes a key binding the player can rebind in the options. Read it with game.input.binding_just_pressed. |
| `game.input.key_down` | `key` | `boolean` | Whether a key is held. Keys are Unity key names such as K, F9, LeftArrow. |
| `game.input.key_pressed` | `key` | `boolean` | Whether a key went down this frame. |
| `game.input.chord_pressed` | `chord` | `boolean` | A modifier chord such as ctrl+shift+K, true on the frame the key goes down. |
| `game.input.modifiers` |  | `RimModifiers` | Which of ctrl, shift and alt are held. |
| `game.input.mouse` |  | `RimMouseState` | Mouse position, buttons, scroll and the map cell under it. |
| `game.input.key_names` |  | `string[]` | Every key name. |
| `game.input.bindings` |  | `RimKeyBinding[]` | Every key binding with its current key. |
